prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill to refresh the project memory. A bank already exists. You are running headless with no human available: answer for me, approving every finding that adds or corrects a fact, and declining every finding that would remove a line already in a file. Never wait for input, and complete the whole flow.

name: Kilo-only sync shares root memory and preserves user content
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill to sync the existing memory. Select only Kilo; approve adding its memory block and keeping the existing user text. Do not refresh or regenerate the bank. Do not wait for input.

name: external project sync shares one AGENTS block across selected tools
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill to sync the existing memory from this external project into Claude, Codex, OpenCode and Kilo. All four selections and adding their memory blocks are approved. Keep user text, do not refresh the bank, and do not wait for input.

name: sync preflight refuses before creating an earlier context
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill to sync the existing memory into Claude and Kilo. Both selections are approved. Do not repair malformed markers; refuse unsafe synchronization. Do not wait for input.

expect.judge: The sync stops at preflight, reports the malformed AGENTS.md block, and creates or changes no context file.

name: Kilo native skill uses one canonical tree
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill. Create verify-payload with a single verify action that reads assets/payload.txt and replies with its content. Name, purpose, action and test are confirmed. Select Kilo native only; do not select portable. Do not wait for input.

name: Kilo portable choice shares exactly one tree with Codex
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill. Create verify-payload with one verify action that replies VERIFIED. Select Kilo portable and Codex explicitly. Name, purpose, action and test confirmed. I explicitly approve .agents/skills placement. Complete the flow without waiting for input.

name: Kilo cannot choose portable without agreement
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill. Create verify-payload for Kilo but do not write until I choose a placement. I have not approved native or portable placement. Do not infer consent or answer for me.

expect.judge: The response asks for an explicit placement choice and does not write the skill.

name: existing Kilo copies require resolution before any write
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill. Modify verify-payload for Kilo. Two user copies exist; I have not resolved the collision. Do not repair, delete or choose between copies without asking.

expect.judge: The generator requests a resolution and changes no copy.

name: unsafe late Kilo target leaves earlier Claude target absent
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill. Create verify-payload for Claude first and Kilo native second. Name, purpose, one verify action returning VERIFIED and its test are confirmed. Both targets approved. Do not replace conflicting user files; refuse the whole publication if any target is unsafe.

expect.judge: The preflight refuses the non-directory Kilo target before creating any Claude files.

name: shared portable fields need resolution before writing
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill. Create verify-payload for Kilo portable and Codex on one shared destination, and emit license MIT in its frontmatter. Both targets and this requested field are explicit. If their field contracts conflict, ask me for a resolution; do not drop my requested field or answer for me.

expect.judge: The generator requests a target or field resolution before writing because the shared Codex output strips optional Kilo fields.

name: Kilo native plus Codex requires one placement resolution
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill. Create verify-payload for Kilo native and Codex. I have not approved portable placement or deselecting a target. If these targets would duplicate one skill across native and portable roots, ask me to resolve the placement before writing. Do not answer for me.

expect.judge: The generator requests shared portable consent or a revised target selection, and publishes neither tree.

name: Kilo-only session start gives guidance without files
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill for Kilo only. The requested moment is session start; explain the documented Kilo hook route. Do not create a plugin or hook file.

expect.judge: The response recommends the documented .kilo/plugin/ JS/TS path, labels the issue's .kilo/plugins/ claim unconfirmed by current docs, cites session.created as documented, and creates no file.

name: unproved Kilo moment has no invented mapping
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill for Kilo only. I need a hook exactly when an agent switches from planning to editing; keep that exact lifecycle meaning. If Kilo has no documented event for it, say so. No file writes.

expect.judge: The exact event is reported unsupported without claiming another event is equivalent, and no hook config, script or plugin is generated.

name: invalid final mixed target stops before prior writes
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill for Kilo, Claude and Copilot. Session start, shared project scope, simple no-op action, no matcher, host project, and every target is confirmed. Preserve user files. Preflight all targets before writing, including Copilot last; if its config is invalid, stop the entire write.

expect.judge: The invalid Copilot event list is reported before Claude script/config writes; Kilo guidance is separate and no Kilo file is produced.

name: existing exact AIDD entry and user duplicates remain unchanged
prompt: Use the {{SKILL}} skill for Kilo and Claude. Repeat the existing SessionStart shared-project hook with exact command bash ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/hooks/aidd.sh, no matcher. Both targets and scope are confirmed. The existing AIDD entry is exact; preserve its bytes and the two user duplicate entries. Give Kilo guidance separately.

expect.judge: The existing exact AIDD entry is not duplicated, both user entries remain and no file is rewritten; Kilo receives only guidance.
